ach-all-body: Every title watched. See you at the cinema.
ach-dune-body: All of Dune watched. Arrakis awaits.
ach-first-body: First title down. Only the whole saga to go.
ach-half-body: Half the list is done — as all things should be.
ach-phase-body: Every Phase {{n}} title in your plan is watched.
ach-ten-body: Ten titles watched. Keep the snacks coming.
all-done: Every title watched. You are ready for Dunesday!
ask-failed: That didn’t go through. Try again.
ask-offline: Couldn’t reach Buddy. Check your connection.
ask-on-track: Am I on track? What could I cut?
ask-remember: What should I remember before Doomsday?
ask-skippable: Which shows are safe to skip?
ask-slow-down: Whoa, lots of questions! Give it a minute and try again.
auto-replan-hint: Missed a night? The plan reshuffles what’s left across the days you have.
avg-auto: Calculated for you. Switch to “set my pace” to choose your own.
behind_one: Dengan kecepatan ini kamu selesai {{finish}}, terlambat {{count}} hari.
behind_other: At this pace you finish {{finish}}, {{count}} days late.
buddy-ai-note: AI can be wrong about details.
buddy-hello: Hey! I know your plan and I know these movies. Ask about tonight, your pace, or any film — recaps, characters, what matters for December.
buddy-mood-open: (Online) — spoilers allowed, you asked for it
buddy-mood-shield: (Online) — spoiler shield up, ask me anything
cal-hint: A subscription, not a one-off file: every watch night appears at your start time, and your calendar re-plans itself when you tick titles off or skip a night (calendars refresh every hour or so).
connect-intro: Subscribe to your plan in Apple, Google or Outlook Calendar, follow it in any RSS reader, and get tonight’s lineup and your progress posted to a Discord channel. Everything updates by itself as you tick titles off.
connect-privacy: This saves a copy of your plan on RMH Studios under a private, unguessable link. No account needed. Anyone with the calendar or RSS link can see your watch list, but only this browser can change it. You can turn it off any time, which deletes the copy.
copy-failed: Couldn’t copy — your browser blocked the clipboard.
custom-hint: Sony’s Spider-Man films, the Fox X-Men, Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D., the Netflix Defenders — anything you want in the run.
device-copied: Link copied. Open it on your other device — keep it private, it can edit your plan.
discord-daily: Post tonight’s lineup an hour before I start
discord-hint: In Discord: Channel Settings → Integrations → Webhooks → New Webhook → Copy Webhook URL, then paste it here. Great for a watch-party server.
discord-progress: Post when I finish titles and phases
discord-replace: Webhook ({{masked}}) — paste a new one to replace it
discord-test-ok: Test message sent — check the channel.
empty-plan: Nothing to schedule. Tick some titles in the watch list below to build a plan.
finale-dune: Paul’s story continues. Two films to rewatch.
finale-mcu: The MCU’s next team-up. Every film and series counts.
footer-made: Made at RMH Studios · Best viewed with a bowl of popcorn
footer-note: Runtimes are theatrical cuts; series totals marked ≈ are estimates — tap any runtime to correct it. Your plan is saved in this browser only. A fan-made planner, not affiliated with Marvel Studios, Disney, Legendary or Warner Bros.
ics-done: Calendar file downloaded — open it to add every night.
impossible: Even round-the-clock viewing can’t fit it all before {{deadline}}. Trim the list.
link-copied: Share link copied. Friends get your list and pace, not your progress.
mix-skipped_other: {{count}} titles left out of the plan.
mode-fit-hint: We find the smallest daily average that still finishes on time.
mode-pace-hint: You pick the average; we tell you when you finish.
month-hint: Darker days are longer nights. Tap a future day to take it off (or put it back). Green ring: today · gold ring: your deadline.
on-track_one: Sesuai jalur: kamu selesai {{finish}}, sisa {{count}} hari.
on-track_other: On track: you finish {{finish}}, {{count}} days to spare.
overrun-hint: Higher means fewer cliffhangers split across nights, but some longer evenings.
overrun-label: Let a night run long by up to {{pct}}%
replanning-from: Re-planning from today ({{date}}) because your start date has passed.
rhythm-hint: The average stays the same; the rhythm decides which days carry more of it.
rss-hint: Tonight’s lineup plus every title you finish. Works with any feed reader or RSS-to-anything bridge.
share-imported: Loaded a shared plan. Your own progress is kept.
skip-hint: Travel, exams, a party? Days off get nothing scheduled.
split-films-hint: Endgame in two sittings instead of one 3-hour night.
sync-disable-confirm: Click again — links will stop working
sync-error: Couldn’t save — will retry on your next change
sync-failed: Couldn’t turn sync on. Try again in a moment.
sync-lost: Your synced copy no longer exists, so sync was turned off. Your plan is still here.
sync-off: Sync is off and the online copy is deleted.
sync-on: Sync is on. Your calendar, RSS and Discord links are ready.
sync-restored: Synced plan loaded on this device.
tagline: Avengers: Doomsday and Dune: Part Three open the same day. Pick your start date and your pace, and get a night-by-night plan that finishes every film and show before the lights go down.
